biggest_catch: The friend must sustain two of three engagement behaviors (min $500 monthly direct deposit, eStatements, 10 transactions/month) for a full 90-day engagement period - and neither side is paid until that period completes, so the earliest payout is ~4 months out.
catches: Referrer must be in good standing at the time of referral; both parties 18+.

Friend must: be a new member (not a Seattle CU member in the last 12 months); open a checking account with promo code REFER; engage in at least 2 of 3 within the 90-day engagement period: (1) min $500 monthly direct deposit, (2) eStatements, (3) 10 transactions/month.
$100 Referral Bonus to the referrer and $100 Welcome Bonus to the friend once the 90-day engagement period completes.
Bonuses posted within 30 business days of completing the 90-day engagement period; adding joint owners does not qualify.
$600+ in bonuses in a calendar year reported on Form 1099-MISC.
No referral-count cap stated; limited time offer; Seattle CU can cancel/amend at any time without notice.

steps: Share your Seattle CU referral with a friend and give them the promo code REFER.
Friend joins as a new member and opens a checking account using promo code REFER.
Friend meets at least 2 of 3 engagement qualifiers (min $500 monthly direct deposit, eStatements, 10 transactions/month) across the 90-day engagement period.
You receive a $100 Referral Bonus in your savings within 30 business days of the period completing.
timing: $100 Referral Bonus posted to the referring member's savings within 30 business days of completing the 90-day engagement period.
when_cash_arrives: $100 Referral Bonus posted to the referring member's savings within 30 business days of completing the 90-day engagement period. Terms impose a fixed waiting period after the friend's account opens - nothing arrives before that date.
maximize: Refer early and have your friend complete ALL qualifying activity in the first days of the window - late qualification pushes the fixed payout date even further out.
Both accounts must stay open and in good standing through the entire wait - early closure forfeits the bonus.
Structural reason it cannot be faster: the program's terms lock payout to a fixed date (60-120 days out) regardless of how fast your friend qualifies.
